passages.title: Learning policy: training budget
passages.heading: Additions
passages.meta: version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-07-01 to the day before 2026-03-01 · superseded by: HB-07
passages.text: For employees who hold a team-lead role, 500 EUR per year was added to the standard annual training budget. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

passages.title: Learning policy: training budget
passages.heading: Additions
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-03-01 · supersedes: HB-06
passages.text: For employees who hold a team-lead role, 500 EUR per year is added to the standard annual training budget. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred.

passages.title: Learning policy: training budget
passages.heading: Standard annual training budget
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-03-01 · supersedes: HB-06
passages.text: Each employee has an annual training budget of 900 EUR per calendar year. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.title: Memo: annual training budget exceptions
passages.heading: Exception for employees in the security team
passages.text: For employees in the security team, the annual training budget is 2100 EUR per year instead of the standard amount. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section.

passages.title: Policy FAQ
passages.heading: Current annual training budget
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard annual training budget? A: 900 EUR per year, as set in HB-07 §2 (effective 2026-03-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-09.

passages.title: Learning policy: training budget
passages.heading: Standard annual training budget
passages.meta: version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-07-01 to the day before 2026-03-01 · superseded by: HB-07
passages.text: Each employee has an annual training budget of 1350 EUR per calendar year. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location.
